f.title: Submit the consolidated renewal dossier with ADR and PSUR assessment at least nine months before MA expiry
f.statement: At least nine months before the marketing authorisation expires, the MAH shall submit to the Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG) a consolidated version of the dossier on quality, safety and efficacy, including the variations made since the MA was granted and an evaluation of suspected adverse reaction reports and periodic safety update reports submitted under Chapter 8.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 47, tweede lid)

rows.deadline: At least nine months before the MA expires
rows.quote:
De houder van de handelsvergunning legt ten minste negen maanden voordat de handelsvergunning haar geldigheid verliest, aan het College een geconsolideerde versie van het dossier voor dat betrekking heeft op de kwaliteit, veiligheid en werkzaamheid van het geneesmiddel, waarin tevens zijn opgenomen: a. wijzigingen die zijn aangebracht sinds de verlening van de handels-
vergunning, en b. beoordeling van meldingen van vermoedelijke bijwerkingen en periodieke veiligheidsverslagen die overeenkomstig hoofdstuk 8 van deze wet zijn ingediend.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 47, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall submit to the Board, at least nine months before the marketing authorisation ceases to be valid, a consolidated version of the dossier relating to the quality, safety and efficacy of the medicinal product, which also includes: a. variations made since the marketing authorisation was granted, and b. an evaluation of reports of suspected adverse reactions and periodic safety update reports submitted in accordance with Chapter 8 of this Act.

f.title: Keep product information up to date with current science and EU web-portal outcomes
f.statement: The MAH shall ensure that the product information is adapted to current scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of assessments and recommendations made public via the European medicines web portal.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, tweede lid)

rows.quote:
De houder van de handelsvergunning draagt zorg voor de aanpassing van de productinformatie aan de actuele wetenschappelijke kennis, met inbegrip van de conclusies van beoordelingen en aanbevelingen die openbaar worden gemaakt via het Europese webportaal voor geneesmid-
delen.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall ensure that the product information is adapted to current scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of assessments and recommendations made public via the European medicines web portal.

f.title: Include positive and negative trial results and off-label use data in new benefit-risk information
f.statement: The new information the MAH must provide (Art. 49(4)) covers both positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies in all indications and populations, whether or not included in the MA, as well as data on use of the medicinal product outside the terms of the MA.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, vierde lid, addition)

rows.quote: De informatie betreft zowel positieve als negatieve resultaten van klinische proeven of andere onderzoeken voor indicaties en populaties, ongeacht of deze in de handelsvergunning zijn opgenomen, alsmede gegevens over gebruik van het geneesmiddel in afwijking van de voorschriften van de handelsvergunning.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, vierde lid, addition)
rows.review_note: Review: this text only adds a sentence to art. 49(4); the underlying duty to supply new information is in the existing article, not reproduced here. Double-check: scope of 'De informatie' inferred from the Act's structure, so below 90; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The information concerns both positive and negative results of clinical trials or other studies for indications and populations, whether or not included in the marketing authorisation, as well as data on use of the medicinal product outside the terms of the marketing authorisation.

f.title: Provide a PSMF copy within seven days of a request by the CBG or the Health Inspectorate
f.statement: At the request of the Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG) or the Health Care Inspectorate, the MAH shall provide a copy of the pharmacovigilance system master file within seven days.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, vijfde lid, addition)

rows.quote: Op verzoek van het College of het Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid verstrekt de houder van de handelsvergunning binnen zeven dagen een kopie van het basisdossier geneesmiddelenbewakingssysteem.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel G (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 49, vijfde lid, addition)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: At the request of the Board or the State Supervision of Public Health, the marketing authorisation holder shall provide a copy of the pharmacovigilance system master file within seven days.

deadline_rule.applies_to: copy of the PSMF requested by the CBG or the Health Care Inspectorate

f.title: Comply with Chapter 8 PV obligations; non-compliance is a ground to suspend or revoke the MA
f.statement: The CBG may suspend or revoke the marketing authorisation where the MAH does not comply with the obligations laid down in Chapter 8 (pharmacovigilance), or where conditions imposed under Articles 45a or 45b are not met.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel H (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 51, eerste lid, onderdelen g-h)

rows.quote: g. niet aan voorschriften gesteld krachtens artikel 45a of 45b is voldaan; h. de houder van de handelsvergunning de in hoofdstuk 8 neergelegde verplichtingen niet nakomt;
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel H (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 51, eerste lid, onderdelen g-h)
rows.review_note: Review: art. 51(1) lists grounds on which the Board may suspend or revoke an MA (lead-in not reproduced in this amending text). Double-check: sanction ground rather than a stand-alone duty, so below 90; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: g. conditions imposed under Article 45a or 45b have not been met; h. the marketing authorisation holder does not comply with the obligations laid down in Chapter 8;

f.title: Package leaflet must invite patients to report suspected ADRs and explain how
f.statement: The package leaflet shall contain a statement expressly asking the patient to report all suspected adverse reactions to his or her doctor, pharmacist or other healthcare professional, or directly to the body of healthcare professionals and patient organisations referred to in Art. 76(3) (the national reporting centre), and shall indicate how such reports can be made.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel J (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 71, derde lid)

rows.quote:
De bijsluiter bevat een vermelding waarin de patiënt uitdrukkelijk wordt verzocht alle vermoedelijke bijwerkingen aan zijn arts, apotheker, of andere beroepsbeoefenaar te melden, dan wel die vermoedelijke bijwerkingen rechtstreeks te melden aan een orgaan van beroepsbeoefe-
naren en patiëntenorganisaties in de gezondheidszorg als bedoeld in artikel 76, derde lid. In de bijsluiter wordt aangegeven op welke wijze dergelijke meldingen kunnen worden gemaakt.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel J (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 71, derde lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The package leaflet shall contain a statement in which the patient is expressly asked to report all suspected adverse reactions to his doctor, pharmacist or other healthcare professional, or to report those suspected adverse reactions directly to a body of healthcare professionals and patient organisations in healthcare as referred to in Article 76(3). The package leaflet shall indicate how such reports can be made.

f.title: Show the additional monitoring statement with the black symbol in the leaflet
f.statement: For a medicinal product referred to in Article 23 of Regulation (EC) 726/2004 (additional monitoring), the statement 'This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring' shall be included, preceded by the black symbol referred to in Article 23 and followed by a standard explanatory sentence.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel J (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 71, vierde lid)
f.applicability: Products on the additional monitoring list

rows.quote: Indien sprake is van een geneesmiddel als bedoeld in artikel 23 van de verordening, wordt de volgende vermelding opgenomen: «Dit geneesmiddel is onderworpen aan aanvullende monitoring». Deze vermelding wordt voorafgegaan door het in artikel 23 van de verordening bedoelde zwarte symbool en gevolgd door een standaardtoelichting.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel J (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 71, vierde lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: In the case of a medicinal product referred to in Article 23 of the Regulation, the following statement shall be included: 'This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring'. This statement shall be preceded by the black symbol referred to in Article 23 of the Regulation and followed by a standard explanatory sentence.

f.title: Operate a pharmacovigilance system that links to the CBG's PV system
f.statement: The MAH shall contribute to the pharmacovigilance of the medicinal products covered by its MA by applying a pharmacovigilance system that connects with the pharmacovigilance system of the Medicines Evaluation Board (Art. 76(1)). Further rules on the MAH's PV tasks are set by ministerial regulation. Chapter 8 does not apply to homeopathic medicinal products referred to in Art. 42(3).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 76a, eerste lid)
f.exceptions: Homeopathic medicinal products under Geneesmiddelenwet art. 42(3) (art. 81).

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning draagt bij aan de bewaking van geneesmiddelen waarop de handelsvergunning betrekking heeft door een geneesmiddelenbewakingssysteem toe te passen dat aansluit op het geneesmiddelenbewakingssysteem, bedoeld in artikel 76, eerste lid.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 76a, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall contribute to the monitoring of the medicinal products to which the marketing authorisation relates by applying a pharmacovigilance system that connects with the pharmacovigilance system referred to in Article 76(1).

f.title: Take responsibility for public communications on PV-based risk information
f.statement: The MAH and the Medicines Evaluation Board are each separately responsible for public announcements, based on pharmacovigilance data, about risks in the use of medicinal products; rules on these announcements are set by ministerial regulation.

rows.quote:
De houder van de handelsvergunning en het College dragen ieder afzonderlijk zorg voor openbare mededelingen op basis van geneesmid-
delenbewakingsgegevens over risico's in het gebruik van geneesmid-
delen.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder and the Board shall each separately be responsible for public announcements based on pharmacovigilance data about risks in the use of medicinal products.

f.title: Record all suspected adverse reactions from the EU and third countries, whatever the source
f.statement: The MAH shall record all suspected adverse reactions occurring in the EU or in third countries that are brought to its attention, irrespective of the reporting system or post-authorisation study from which they originate. Further rules on recording and reporting are set by ministerial regulation.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 78, eerste lid)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning registreert alle vermoedelijke bijwerkingen die zich voordoen in de Europese Unie of in derdelanden en hem ter kennis worden gebracht, ongeacht van welk meldingssysteem of welke studie na toelating deze afkomstig zijn.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 78, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall record all suspected adverse reactions occurring in the European Union or in third countries that are brought to its attention, irrespective of the reporting system or post-authorisation study from which they originate.

f.title: Submit PSURs electronically to the EMA
f.statement: The MAH shall submit periodic safety update reports electronically to the European Medicines Agency. Further rules on content, submission and frequency are set by ministerial regulation.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 78a, eerste lid)

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning dient elektronisch periodieke veiligheidsverslagen in bij het Bureau.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 78a, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall submit periodic safety update reports electronically to the Agency.

f.title: Do not conduct non-interventional PASS that would promote use of the product
f.statement: Non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies shall not be carried out where the conduct of the study would promote the use of a medicinal product. This applies only to studies started after 21 July 2012 (art. 122(2)).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80, eerste lid)

rows.quote: Niet-interventionele veiligheidsstudies na toelating worden niet uitgevoerd wanneer de uitvoering van de studie het gebruik van een geneesmiddel zou bevorderen.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies shall not be carried out where the conduct of the study would promote the use of a medicinal product.

f.title: Pay healthcare professionals in non-interventional PASS only for time and expenses
f.statement: For their participation in non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies, healthcare professionals shall receive only compensation for the time spent and the expenses incurred.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80, tweede lid)

rows.quote: Voor hun deelname aan niet-interventionele veiligheidsstudies na toelating ontvangen beroepsbeoefenaren uitsluitend een vergoeding voor de daaraan bestede tijd en daarvoor gemaakte kosten.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel L (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: provision is worded on the HCP's receipt of payment; the MAH as study sponsor/payer is the actor who must comply. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For their participation in non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies, healthcare professionals shall receive only a payment for the time spent on it and the costs incurred.

f.title: Follow Directive Art. 107h(1) and (3) in signal detection
f.statement: In signal detection activities under Chapter 8, the Medicines Evaluation Board and the MAH shall observe Article 107h(1) and (3) of Directive 2001/83/EC.

rows.quote: In het kader van werkzaamheden op het gebied van signaaldetectie met betrekking tot dit hoofdstuk nemen het College en de houder van de handelsvergunning artikel 107nonies, eerste en derde lid, van richtlijn 2001/83 in acht.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; Dutch legislative present tense states a binding duty (Mandatory); statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: In the context of signal detection activities relating to this chapter, the Board and the marketing authorisation holder shall observe Article 107h(1) and (3) of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: PSMF for MAs granted before 21 July 2012: from renewal, at the latest from 21 July 2015
f.statement: For marketing authorisations granted before 21 July 2012, the MAH's obligation under Art. 76a(2) to keep a pharmacovigilance system master file and make it available on request applies from the date the MA is renewed, but at the latest from 21 July 2015.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, eerste lid)

rows.deadline: From MA renewal, at the latest from 21 July 2015
rows.quote: Voor handelsvergunningen die vóór 21 juli 2012 zijn verleend geldt de verplichting van de houder van de handelsvergunning, opgelegd bij en krachtens artikel 76a, tweede lid, van deze wet om een basisdossier Staatsblad 2013 21 9 geneesmiddelenbewakingssysteem bij te houden en dit op verzoek ter beschikking te stellen, vanaf de datum waarop die handelsvergunningen worden verlengd, doch uiterlijk vanaf 21 juli 2015.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: quote includes the running page header that interrupts the sentence. Double-check: quote proves duty and date; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For marketing authorisations granted before 21 July 2012, the obligation of the marketing authorisation holder, imposed by and under Article 76a(2) of this Act, to keep a [page header: Staatsblad 2013 21, p. 9] pharmacovigilance system master file and make it available on request, applies from the date on which those marketing authorisations are renewed, but at the latest from 21 July 2015.

deadline_rule.applies_to: PSMF for MAs granted before 21 July 2012

f.title: EudraVigilance ICSR reporting applies six months after EMA announces functional specifications
f.statement: The MAH's obligation under Art. 78 to report suspected adverse reactions to the EudraVigilance database applies from six months after the EudraVigilance functional specifications have been established and announced by the EMA.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, derde lid)

rows.quote: De verplichting van de houder van de handelsvergunning bij en krachtens artikel 78 van deze wet om melding te maken van vermoedelijke bijwerkingen in de Eudravigilance-databank geldt vanaf zes maanden nadat de functiespecificaties van de Eudravigilance-databank tot stand zijn gebracht en door het Bureau bekend zijn gemaakt.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, derde lid)
rows.review_note: Review: transitional commencement rule (no calendar date in the text). Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The obligation of the marketing authorisation holder under Article 78 of this Act to report suspected adverse reactions to the EudraVigilance database applies from six months after the functional specifications of the EudraVigilance database have been established and announced by the Agency.

f.title: Interim: report serious EU ADRs within 15 days to the Member State where they occurred; third-country cases to EMA
f.statement: Until EudraVigilance meets the functional specifications, the MAH shall report suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in the EU to the competent authority of the Member State where they occurred at the latest within fifteen days of becoming aware of them; for third-country cases the MAH shall also report to the EMA and, on request, to the competent authorities of the Member States where the product is authorised.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vierde lid, onderdeel a)
f.applicability: Transitional period until EudraVigilance met its functional specifications

rows.deadline: At the latest 15 days after becoming aware
rows.quote: maakt de houder van de handelsvergunning uiterlijk binnen vijftien dagen na kennisneming van vermoedelijke ernstige bijwerkingen die zich binnen de Europese Unie voordoen, melding hiervan aan de bevoegde autoriteit van de lidstaat waar deze zich hebben voorgedaan. Indien het gaat om een derdeland, maakt de houder van de handelsvergunning tevens melding aan het Bureau, en, op verzoek, aan de bevoegde autoriteiten van de lidstaten waar het geneesmiddel is toegelaten;
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vierde lid, onderdeel a)
rows.review_note: Review: transitional rule, spent once EudraVigilance centralised reporting applied. Double-check: kept for completeness; below 90 as historical.
rows.quote_en: the marketing authorisation holder shall report, at the latest within fifteen days of becoming aware of them, suspected serious adverse reactions occurring within the European Union to the competent authority of the Member State where they occurred. In the case of a third country, the marketing authorisation holder shall also report to the Agency and, on request, to the competent authorities of the Member States where the medicinal product is authorised;

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious suspected ADRs (transitional regime before EudraVigilance centralisation)

f.title: Interim: CBG may require reporting of all Dutch ADRs within 90 days
f.statement: Until EudraVigilance meets the functional specifications, the Medicines Evaluation Board may require the MAH to report to it all suspected adverse reactions occurring in the Netherlands, at the latest within ninety days of becoming aware of them.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vierde lid, onderdeel b)
f.applicability: Transitional period until EudraVigilance met its functional specifications; only where the CBG imposes it

rows.deadline: At the latest 90 days after becoming aware (if required by the CBG)
rows.quote: kan het College de houder van de handelsvergunning verplichten hem alle vermoedelijke bijwerkingen die zich binnen het Nederlands grondgebied voordoen, te melden, uiterlijk binnen negentig dagen na kennisneming;
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vierde lid, onderdeel b)
rows.review_note: Review: transitional and conditional on a CBG requirement. Double-check: below 90 as historical.
rows.quote_en: the Board may require the marketing authorisation holder to report to it all suspected adverse reactions occurring within Dutch territory, at the latest within ninety days of becoming aware of them;

deadline_rule.applies_to: all suspected ADRs occurring in the Netherlands, if required by the CBG (transitional)

f.title: Interim PSUR submission to Member States until the EU PSUR repository applies
f.statement: The obligation to send PSURs to the EMA applies from twelve months after the functional specifications of the central PSUR repository have been established and announced by the EMA; until the repository meets the agreed specifications, the MAH shall send PSURs to the Member States where the product is authorised.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vijfde en zesde lid)
f.applicability: Transitional period until the PSUR repository met its functional specifications

rows.quote:
Totdat het Bureau er zorg voor heeft gedragen dat het register van periodieke veiligheidsverslagen voldoet aan de overeengekomen functiespecificaties, zendt de houder van de handelsvergunning perio-
dieke veiligheidsverslagen aan de lidstaten waar het geneesmiddel is toegelaten.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, vijfde en zesde lid)
rows.review_note: Review: transitional rule, spent once the PSUR repository became mandatory. Double-check: below 90 as historical.
rows.quote_en: Until the Agency has ensured that the repository of periodic safety update reports meets the agreed functional specifications, the marketing authorisation holder shall send periodic safety update reports to the Member States where the medicinal product is authorised.

dates.title: Netherlands Medicines Act (Stb. 2013, 21): PSMF required for MAs granted before 21 July 2012
dates.scope: Holders of marketing authorisations granted before 21 July 2012: keep a PSMF and make it available on request, from MA renewal and at the latest from 21 July 2015
dates.quote: vanaf de datum waarop die handelsvergunningen worden verlengd, doch uiterlijk vanaf 21 juli 2015.
dates.quote_en: from the date on which those marketing authorisations are renewed, but at the latest from 21 July 2015.
dates.location: Artikel I, onderdeel S (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 122, eerste lid)
dates.timing_note: The Act itself enters into force on a date set by Royal Decree (Artikel II), not stated in this text, so no effective date is recorded.
